coverage_explanation: The required behavior depends on RTC_DS1307 time crossing 2024-11-24T04:49:00. The circuit specifies an initial RTC time of 2024-11-24T04:48:55, but the disclosed host API provides no RTC initialization or time-input facility and does not guarantee importing the circuit's initTime attribute. Consequently, a test cannot reliably establish the required silent-before and sounding-after conditions. Checking only the buzzer pin mode would not meaningfully test the alarm behavior.
assumptions: Preserve the DS1307 I2C wiring on A4/A5 and the passive piezo buzzer on pin 8.
The circuit requires the RTC to start at 2024-11-24T04:48:55; no disclosed host-API mechanism establishes that state.
The tone frequency is unspecified; any audible carrier frequency is permitted when the alarm condition holds.
